text: Given no per-call anchor override, When exo_convert_mailbox_to_shared is called with an email-shaped identity under tenant-domain-form credentials, Then the Set-Mailbox call carries the session-level system-mailbox anchor, not an identity-specific one (reproduction baseline the fix changes)

Given ExoClient.invoke is called with anchor_override='UPN:x@y.com', When the request is sent, Then X-AnchorMailbox is 'UPN:x@y.com', taking priority over both an explicit X-Exo-Anchor-Mailbox header and the system-mailbox default

Given identity='alice@contoso.com', When exo_convert_mailbox_to_shared is called, Then its Set-Mailbox call carries X-AnchorMailbox='UPN:alice@contoso.com' and (mocked upstream success) the response is converted:true
Given a successful conversion, When exo_get_mailbox is called afterward, Then recipient_type_details reads SharedMailbox
Given a mailbox whose mocked upstream state is already SharedMailbox, When exo_convert_mailbox_to_shared is called again, Then the response is converted:true with no error
Given a mocked 400 response whose message contains 'CmdletProxyNotAvailableException', When the error is classified, Then error.code=upstream_unavailable and retryable=true

Given a mocked 400 response with the ticket's literal message 'Cmdlet needs proxy. Current Server FQDN: ..., Required Server FQDN: ...; CmdletProxyNotAvailableException', When the error is classified, Then the result matches TC-EXO-006 (error.code=upstream_unavailable, retryable=true)

Given a mocked 400 response whose message matches neither the proxy markers nor the not-found markers, When the error is classified, Then it still falls through to invalid_argument/false, distinct from upstream_unavailable and not_found
Given identity is a GUID (no '@'), When exo_convert_mailbox_to_shared is called, Then its Set-Mailbox call carries no anchor_override beyond the session default

Given a live or sandbox GDAP tenant reproducing the exact ticket conditions, When Agent SOP 230 calls exo_convert_mailbox_to_shared(customer_tenant_id=151b79b6-aa51-4a81-b19c-95142331cb4c, identity=quinn.ellis@2qmxyw.onmicrosoft.com) followed by exo_get_mailbox, Then the response is converted:true and recipient_type_details reads SharedMailbox (today it fails with CmdletProxyNotAvailableException)
steps: Obtain app-only credentials (certificate) for a GDAP-connected tenant where a target mailbox is confirmed hosted on a different Exchange backend server than the connector's default/session anchor
Call exo_convert_mailbox_to_shared with that mailbox's identity
Call exo_get_mailbox on the same identity and read recipient_type_details
expect: exo_convert_mailbox_to_shared returns {"converted": true, ...}; exo_get_mailbox's recipient_type_details reads "SharedMailbox"; no CmdletProxyNotAvailableException in either response
evidence: [需求缺失/INCOMPLETE] not executed in this design tick -- this pipeline's sandbox has no reachable Exchange/GDAP session (see docs/tickets/PRD-20977.md Tech design §9/§11). This is the gating manual step before trusting AC1 in production, owned by whoever has GDAP tenant access; it does not block merging the code.
